clf_cats_class.doc: CATS classifier broad class prediction with the highest probability. -1= not processed, 11=SN-like, 12=Fast (e.g. KN, ulens, Novae, ...), 13=Long (e.g. SLSN, TDE, ...), 21=Periodic (e.g. RRLyrae, EB, ...), 22=Non-periodic (e.g. AGN). See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08798

clf_cats_score.doc: CATS classifier highest probability (0...1). See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08798

clf_earlySNIa_score.doc: Score (0...1) for the early SN Ia classifier (binary classifier). See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08798

clf_elephant_kstest_science.doc: hostless indicator in the science image from the ELEPHANT pipeline. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18165

clf_elephant_kstest_template.doc: hostless indicator in the template image from the ELEPHANT pipeline. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18165

clf_snnSnVsOthers_score.doc: Score (0...1) for the SN classifier (binary classifier) using SuperNNova. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08798

fink_broker_version.doc: fink-broker schema version used to process the alert

fink_science_version.doc: fink-science schema version used to process the alert

firstDiaSourceMjdTaiFink.doc: MJD for the first detection by Rubin. Temporary replacement for diaObject.firstDiaSourceMjdTai which is not yet populated by the project

is_cataloged.doc: True if the last diaSource (alert) of the diaObject (object) has a counterpart in either SIMBAD or Gaia DR3. False otherwise.

is_first.doc: True if the alert is not a Solar System object and has no history (first detection at this location).

is_sso.doc: True if the diaSource is associate to a known Solar System object. False otherwise.

lsst_schema_version.doc: LSST schema version used to generate the alert

main_label_classifier.doc: Main prediction from Fink classifiers for the last received alert of this object. This is currently set to the CATS prediction only (f:clf_cats_class). Subject to change.

main_label_crossmatch.doc: Main association from various crossmatches for the last received alert of this object. This is currently set to the SIMBAD label only (f:xm_simbad_otype). Subject to change.

xm_gaiadr3_DR3Name.doc: Unique source designation of closest source from Gaia catalog; if exists within 1 arcsec.

xm_gaiadr3_Plx.doc: Absolute stellar parallax (in milli-arcsecond) of the closest source from Gaia catalog; if exists within 1 arcsec.

xm_gaiadr3_VarFlag.doc: Photometric variability flag from Gaia DR3. 1 if the source is variable, 0 otherwise.

xm_gaiadr3_e_Plx.doc: Standard error of the stellar parallax (in milli-arcsecond) of the closest source from Gaia catalog; if exists within 1 arcsec.

xm_gcvs_type.doc: Object type of the closest source from GCVS catalog; if exists within 1 arcsec.

xm_legacydr8_e_zphot.doc: Uncertainty on zphot from Legacy Surveys DR8 South Photometric Redshifts catalog - standard deviation of the normally distributed photo-z posterior.

xm_legacydr8_fqual.doc: Photo-z reliability flag from Legacy Surveys DR8 South Photometric Redshifts catalog. =1 for sources expected to have well-constrained estimates

xm_legacydr8_pstar.doc: Star likelihood based on colours from GMM star-QSO classification (Legacy Surveys DR8 South Photometric Redshifts catalog)

xm_legacydr8_zphot.doc: Photo-z estimate from Legacy Surveys DR8 South Photometric Redshifts catalog - mean of the normally distributed photo-z posterior

xm_mangrove_2MASS_name.doc: 2MASS source designation of closest source from Mangrove catalog; if exists within 1 arcmin.

xm_mangrove_HyperLEDA_name.doc: HyperLEDA source designation of closest source from Mangrove catalog; if exists within 1 arcmin.

xm_mangrove_ang_dist.doc: Angular distance of closest source from Mangrove catalog; if exists within 1 arcmin.

xm_mangrove_lum_dist.doc: Luminosity distance of closest source from Mangrove catalog; if exists within 1 arcmin.

xm_simbad_otype.doc: Object type of the closest source from SIMBAD database; if exists within 1 arcsec. See https://api.lsst.fink-portal.org/api/v1/classes

xm_spicy_class.doc: Class name of closest source from SPICY catalog; if exists within 1.2 arcsec.

xm_tns_redshift.doc: Redshift from TNS, if it exists.

xm_vsx_Type.doc: Object type of the closest source from VSX catalog; if exists within 1 arcsec.

xm_x3hsp_type.doc: Counterpart (cross-match) to the 3HSP catalog if exists within 1 arcminute.

xm_x4lac_type.doc: Counterpart (cross-match) to the 4LAC DR3 catalog if exists within 1 arcminute.

apFlux.doc: Flux in a 12 pixel radius aperture on the difference image [nJy].

apFlux_flag.doc: General aperture flux algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when measuring aperture fluxes. Another apFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information.

apFlux_flag_apertureTruncated.doc: Aperture did not fit within measurement image.

band.doc: Filter band this source was observed with.

bboxSize.doc: Size of the square bounding box that fully contains the detection footprint [pixel].

centroid_flag.doc: General centroid algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when fitting the centroid. Another centroid flag field should also be set to provide more information.

dec.doc: Declination coordinate of the position of the object [deg].

detector.doc: Id of the detector where this diaSource was measured. Datatype short instead of byte because of DB concerns about unsigned bytes.

dipoleAngle.doc: Maximum likelihood fit of the angle between the meridian through the centroid and the dipole direction (bearing, from negative to positive lobe) [deg].

dipoleChi2.doc: Chi^2 statistic of the model fit.

dipoleFitAttempted.doc: Attempted to fit a dipole model to this source.

dipoleFluxDiff.doc: Maximum likelihood value for the difference of absolute fluxes of the two lobes for a dipole model [nJy].

dipoleLength.doc: Maximum likelihood value for the lobe separation in dipole model [arcsec].

dipoleMeanFlux.doc: Maximum likelihood value for the mean absolute flux of the two lobes for a dipole model [nJy].

dipoleNdata.doc: The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the model.

extendedness.doc: A measure of extendedness, computed by comparing an object's moment-based traced radius to the PSF moments. extendedness = 1 implies a high degree of confidence that the source is extended. extendedness = 0 implies a high degree of confidence that the source is point-like.

firstDiaSourceMjdTai.doc: Time of the first diaSource, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

forced_PsfFlux_flag.doc: Forced PSF photometry on science image failed. Another forced_PsfFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information.

forced_PsfFlux_flag_edge.doc: Forced PSF flux on science image was too close to the edge of the image to use the full PSF model.

forced_PsfFlux_flag_noGoodPixels.doc: Forced PSF flux not enough non-rejected pixels in data to attempt the fit.

g_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for g filter [nJy].

g_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the g band flux errors [nJy].

g_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between g band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

g_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for g filter [nJy].

g_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of g-band data points.

g_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of g_psfFlux [nJy].

g_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for g filter [nJy].

glint_trail.doc: This flag is set if the source is part of a glint trail.

i_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for i filter [nJy].

i_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the i band flux errors [nJy].

i_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between i band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

i_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for i filter [nJy].

i_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of i-band data points.

i_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of i_psfFlux [nJy].

i_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for i filter [nJy].

isDipole.doc: Source well fit by a dipole.

isNegative.doc: Source was detected as significantly negative.

ixx.doc: Adaptive second moment of the source intensity [nJy.arcsec**2].

ixxPSF.doc: Adaptive second moment for the PSF [nJy.arcsec**2].

ixy.doc: Adaptive second moment of the source intensity [nJy.arcsec**2].

ixyPSF.doc: Adaptive second moment for the PSF [nJy.arcsec**2].

iyy.doc: Adaptive second moment of the source intensity [nJy.arcsec**2].

iyyPSF.doc: Adaptive second moment for the PSF [nJy.arcsec**2].

lastDiaSourceMjdTai.doc: Time of the most recent non-forced DIASource for this object, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

midpointMjdTai.doc: Effective mid-visit time for this diaSource, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time [d].

nDiaSources.doc: Total number of DiaSources associated with this DiaObject.

observation_reason.doc: Scheduler reason for the image containing this diaSource (RTN-097).

parentDiaSourceId.doc: Id of the parent diaSource this diaSource has been deblended from, if any.

pixelFlags.doc: General pixel flags failure; set if anything went wrong when setting pixels flags from this footprint's mask. This implies that some pixelFlags for this source may be incorrectly set to False.

pixelFlags_bad.doc: Bad pixel in the DiaSource footprint.

pixelFlags_cr.doc: Cosmic ray in the DiaSource footprint.

pixelFlags_crCenter.doc: Cosmic ray in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_edge.doc: Some of the source footprint is outside usable exposure region (masked EDGE or centroid off image).

pixelFlags_injectedCenter.doc: Injection in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_injected_template.doc: Template injection in the DiaSource footprint.

pixelFlags_injected_templateCenter.doc: Template injection in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_interpolated.doc: Interpolated pixel in the DiaSource footprint.

pixelFlags_interpolatedCenter.doc: Interpolated pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_nodata.doc: NO_DATA pixel in the source footprint.

pixelFlags_nodataCenter.doc: NO_DATA pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_saturated.doc: Saturated pixel in the DiaSource footprint.

pixelFlags_saturatedCenter.doc: Saturated pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_streakCenter.doc: Streak in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

pixelFlags_suspectCenter.doc: Suspect pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid.

psfChi2.doc: Chi^2 statistic of the point source model fit.

psfFlux.doc: Flux for Point Source model. Note this actually measures the flux difference between the template and the visit image [nJy].

psfFlux_flag.doc: Failure to derive linear least-squares fit of psf model. Another psfFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information.

psfFlux_flag_edge.doc: Object was too close to the edge of the image to use the full PSF model.

psfFlux_flag_noGoodPixels.doc: Not enough non-rejected pixels in data to attempt the fit.

psfLnL.doc: Natural log likelihood of the observed data given the point source model.

psfNdata.doc: The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the point source model.

r_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for r filter [nJy].

r_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the r band flux errors [nJy].

r_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between r band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

r_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for r filter [nJy].

r_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of r-band data points.

r_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of r_psfFlux [nJy].

r_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for r filter [nJy].

ra.doc: Right ascension coordinate of the position of the object [deg].

reliability.doc: Probability (0-1) that the diaSource is astrophysical, derived from a machine learning model.

scienceFlux.doc: Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the visit image centered at DiaSource position [nJy].

shape_flag.doc: General source shape algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when measuring the shape. Another shape flag field should also be set to provide more information.

shape_flag_not_contained.doc: Center not contained in footprint bounding box.

shape_flag_parent_source.doc: This source is a parent source; we should only be measuring on deblended children in difference imaging.

snr.doc: The signal-to-noise ratio at which this source was detected in the difference image.

ssObjectId.doc: Id of the ssObject this source was associated with, if any. If not, it is set to NULL (each diaSource will be associated with either a diaObject or ssObject).

target_name.doc: Scheduler target for the image containing this diaSource (RTN-097).

templateFlux.doc: Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the template image centered at the DiaObject position [nJy].

timeProcessedMjdTai.doc: Time when the image was processed and this DiaSource record was generated, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

timeWithdrawnMjdTai.doc: Time when this record was marked invalid, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

trailAngle.doc: Maximum likelihood fit of the angle between the meridian through the centroid and the trail direction (bearing) [deg].

trailChi2.doc: Chi^2 statistic of the trailed source model fit.

trailDec.doc: Declination coordinate of centroid for trailed source model [deg].

trailFlux.doc: Flux for a trailed source model. Note this actually measures the flux difference between the template and the visit image [nJy].

trailLength.doc: Maximum likelihood fit of trail length [arcsec].

trailNdata.doc: The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the trailed source model.

trailRa.doc: Right ascension coordinate of centroid for trailed source model [deg].

trail_flag_edge.doc: This flag is set if a trailed source extends onto or past edge pixels.

u_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for u filter [nJy].

u_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the u band flux errors [nJy].

u_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between u band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

u_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for u filter [nJy].

u_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of u-band data points.

u_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of u_psfFlux [nJy].

u_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for u filter [nJy].

validityStartMjdTai.doc: Processing time when validity of this diaObject starts, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

visit.doc: Id of the visit where this diaSource was measured.

x.doc: x position computed by a centroiding algorithm [pixel].

y.doc: y position computed by a centroiding algorithm [pixel].

y_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for y filter [nJy].

y_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the y band flux errors [nJy].

y_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between y band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

y_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for y filter [nJy].

y_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of y-band data points.

y_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of y_psfFlux [nJy].

y_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for y filter [nJy].

z_fpFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for z filter [nJy].

z_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the z band flux errors [nJy].

z_psfFluxMaxSlope.doc: Maximum slope between z band flux obsevations max(delta_flux/delta_time) [nJy/d].

z_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for z filter [nJy].

z_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of z-band data points.

z_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of z_psfFlux [nJy].

z_scienceFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean forced photometry flux for z filter [nJy].
